checks.message: Provisional geometry is clearly disclosed and never presented as an official redline.
All three key areas retain official_boundary=false and provisional_rough precision.
The Dazhongsi placeholder uncertainty is explicitly disclosed; canonical geometry is not silently moved.
The scaffold's shared-edge partition is preserved while design properties are materially revised.
The package states that no site visit, interview or human-subject experiment was conducted.
No face, gender, pregnancy, disability or health inference is required; synthetic/voluntary data and stop gates are specified.
Twelve scenarios include carrier, groups, dual metrics, data, privacy, operator, human review, baseline, window, success and stop gates.
The visual report is offline, static and free of scripts, forms, iframes and remote dependencies.
All visuals are original; Noto Sans SC is used under SIL OFL 1.1; external cases are citation-only.
Every required section includes claim-adjacent machine-readable evidence.
